title: iRacing Pro Track Guide by Team Conti Sim Performance I NASCAR Xfinity at Dover

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: turn away from the wall before the auto trader sign
corners.exit: start lifting phase near A-post crossing auto trader sign
corners.mistakes: start lifting too late, miss the compression zone

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: left point is slow, stay rolling
corners.line: angle first part of apex, get close to apron
corners.mistakes: overspeed entry, add too much wheel, hit apron

corners.line: Continue rolling, start opening up the line to create a sharper exit
corners.exit: Maintain partial throttle, avoid excessive throttle to prevent rear swing
corners.mistakes: Using too much throttle can cause rear end to break free

corners.label: T2
corners.line: turn down the hill, shape exit fully
corners.mistakes: front end washes out early, delay full throttle

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: lift throttle before getting under the crosswalk, about a car length and a half before
corners.exit: use partial throttle on entry, maintain partial throttle through the corner
corners.mistakes: turning the wheel too much, going wide on the diamond

corners.line: keep left front pinned close to apron

corners.exit: keep wheels narrow to avoid exit wall
Straight exit as much as I can

general_tips: ensure front end is positive and connecting to track with least resistance
Maintain a diamond quality line to exit straighter
keep front and rear as one to one
keep balance consistent into center of corner
use partial throttle to maintain balance
Pointing after the center is key for this track.
Full throttle moments are delayed with hotter tires.
Use partial throttle for stability with hotter tires.
Manage tires at the earliest points
Avoid overusing tires from laps 10 to 20
up the center a little bit and then wrap the exit with a pinched exit as much as you can
